theme: CS5-3 typed lambda params bound to their annotation
text: CHECKER (infer.rs, all engines): a lambda param with a type annotation binds the annotation's skeleton (numeric leaves free, other leaves exact); an annotation with an unresolved part stays a fresh var. So |p: (i64, str)| match p { (a, b) => to_str(b + 1) } is E0102 at check instead of a run panic, and a wrong-arity tuple pattern on such a param is E0102. New refusal of a program that runs: println of a typed lambda's int component (l15; NH-1 (a)). No interpreter or runtime change. The 717 tracked .ax files check with the same exit codes and diagnostics as the base binary.
